facts: Hydrogen chloride — 8 hr group: Butyl; Teflon; Saranex; Barricade; Responder; Trellchem; Tychem.
Hydrogen chloride — 4 hr group: Neoprene; PVC.
The entry includes the hazard language: "Prevent skin contact (solution)/ Frostbite."
The entry includes the consequence statement: "Prevent possible skin freezing from direct liquid contact."

Definition of the time-group labels as used in the table: "8 hr = More than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 micron g/cm2/min; 4 hr = At least 4 but less than 8 hours of resistance to breakthrough >0.1 micron g/cm2/min."
